files.mode: original functions; portable paths and CLI

files.origin: l1_selector_v85.py + FlowCalibrationEngine from l1_calibrate_v94.py + v87 grids
files.mode: remove private data loaders; lazy sklearn imports; display S09; original decision and calibration functions

portable_orchestration: representative_panel.py, representative_task.py, simple_candidates.py and CLIs were assembled for this package; they do not replace the original frozen scientific run.
original_training_policy: l1_runtime_v94.py and l1_train_v94.py; no original scientific admission or resume files modified
data_exports: Frozen aggregate scores, source task descriptors/labels and locked configurations; local paths and internal bookkeeping removed.
source_label_boundary: 20 source tasks carry labels. Eight target tasks have prefix features only. Target scores are in a separate file.

execution_in_this_revision.scope: Synthetic reduced-schedule predictor checks and replay of locked source estimators only.

runtime_check_adapter: scripts/runtime_smoke.py calls the existing training loop with an explicit runtime_smoke option; normal train keeps the unchanged 180-round policy. It also calls the existing source replay and checks one estimator trained without a held-out region.
